The John Zink engineering team works in a collaborative, global environment supporting engineered combustion and emissions-control solutions. You will partner closely with engineering, project teams, manufacturing, shop planning, suppliers, customers, and subject matter experts to solve technical challenges and deliver quality engineering solutions.

* Ensure engineering drawings meet customer requirements, fabrication needs, applicable standards, quality expectations, and project schedules.

* Experience with **Autodesk Inventor 2025 and/or Creo 9**.

We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives. Everyone on the team is encouraged to share ideas, ask questions, and contribute to solving real-world problems.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

As an AI/ML Intern, you will:

* Develop and improve machine learning and AI solutions that address real business challenges.
* Build and maintain data processing and machine learning pipelines.
* Evaluate emerging machine learning and generative AI approaches and apply them where appropriate.
* Analyse data and identify opportunities to improve model performance and business outcomes.

* Enjoys solving problems and working with data.
* Is curious and open to learning new tools, technologies, and ways of working.
* Communicates ideas clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Works well with others and values different perspectives.

**Work on Real Business Challenges**

**Organisation:** Kalike (Associate Organisation of Tata Trusts)

**Reporting to:** Senior Manager – HR & Administration  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Kalike

Kalike is an Associate Organisation of Tata Trusts, working across multiple locations and programmes to strengthen community development and improve the quality of life of underserved communities.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible HR professional to manage payroll, statutory compliance and day-to-day HR operations across our organisation.

Role Purpose

The HR & Payroll Officer will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing, statutory compliance, employee records management and effective implementation of HR processes across Kalike's Head Office and branch locations.

The position will also support recruitment, employee onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, HR reporting and other HR development initiatives.

Key Responsibilities1. Payroll Management

* Manage end-to-end monthly payroll processing for employees across different locations.
* Collect, verify and reconcile monthly attendance, leave, loss of pay, new joiners, exits and salary-related inputs.
* Ensure accurate calculation of salary, allowances, deductions, arrears, reimbursements and final settlements.
* Process payroll inputs in coordination with the Finance and Accounts team.
* Ensure timely preparation and sharing of payroll statements, salary registers and payslips.
* Handle payroll-related employee queries and resolve discrepancies.
* Maintain payroll records, employee salary details and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate full and final settlement calculations for separated employees.

2. Statutory Compliance Management

* Ensure timely compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements across all operating locations.
* Manage monthly, quarterly and annual statutory compliances, including:
* Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)
* Employees' State Insurance (ESI)
* Professional Tax (PT)
* Labour Welfare Fund (LWF)
* TDS coordination relating to salary, wherever applicable
* Shops and Establishments registrations, renewals and returns
* Minimum Wages and applicable wage-related requirements
* Payment of Bonus, Gratuity and other applicable labour law requirements
* Maternity Benefit and other applicable employee welfare provisions
* Maintain statutory registers, records, returns, challans and compliance documentation.
* Track registration renewals, filing deadlines and statutory payments.
* Coordinate with government departments, consultants and statutory authorities whenever required.
* Support labour inspections, audits and statutory assessments.
* Maintain an updated statutory compliance calendar for all applicable locations.

3. HR Operations and Employee Records

* Maintain and regularly update employee master data and personnel records in the HRMS.
* Ensure proper documentation of employee joining, confirmation, transfers, changes in employment status and separation.
* Coordinate with the concerned internal teams for appointment letters, renewal letters and other employee documentation.
* Maintain employee files, attendance records, leave balances and HR-related databases.
* Ensure timely updating of employee information in HR systems.
* Support implementation and effective utilisation of HRMS and employee self-service facilities.

4. Recruitment and Onboarding Support

* Coordinate recruitment activities, including job postings, resume screening, interview scheduling and candidate follow-up.
* Coordinate joining formalities and documentation for new employees.
* Ensure completion of employee onboarding checklists and induction processes.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and joining status reports.

5. Performance Management and Employee Development

* Coordinate the annual performance management and appraisal process.
* Support preparation, communication and tracking of Key Result Areas (KRAs) and performance goals.
* Maintain employee performance records and appraisal documentation.
* Coordinate training programmes, learning initiatives and employee development activities.
* Support employee engagement, feedback and HR development initiatives.

6. HR MIS, Reporting and Audit Support

* Prepare monthly HR MIS covering headcount, attendance, payroll, recruitment, attrition and statutory compliance.
* Generate regular HR reports and dashboards for management review.
* Maintain proper documentation and audit-ready records for HR and payroll activities.
* Support internal audits, external audits and donor compliance requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes through automation and standardisation.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* Graduate or Postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce or a related discipline.
* Approximately 4–6 years of relevant experience in HR operations, payroll processing and statutory compliance.
* Practical working knowledge of payroll processing and applicable Indian labour laws.
* Experience handling payroll and statutory compliance across multiple locations will be an advantage.
* Experience working with HRMS/payroll software such as greytHR, or similar platforms, is preferred.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, HR MIS preparation and employee data management.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong knowledge of payroll processing and statutory compliance.
* Good understanding of applicable labour laws and statutory filing requirements.
* High accuracy and attention to detail in salary calculations and compliance documentation.
* Strong Excel and HRMS working skills.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and work independently.
* Strong documentation, record-keeping and analytical skills.
* High level of confidentiality, integrity and accountability.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed based on:

* Timely and accurate monthly payroll processing.
* 100% on-time completion of applicable statutory filings and payments.
* Accuracy and timely reconciliation of attendance and payroll inputs.
* Maintenance of updated employee records and HRMS data.
* Timely completion of recruitment and onboarding documentation.
* Timely preparation of HR MIS and management reports.
* Effective coordination of performance management and employee development activities.
* Audit readiness and timely closure of HR compliance observations.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive HR professional who can independently manage payroll and statutory compliance, maintain accurate employee records and support the development of structured HR processes in a growing multi-location organisation.

* AI-enabled process improvement: Identify and assess opportunities to apply Generative AI, machine learning, Python, SQL, APIs and automation tools to operational workflows. Design, configure, test and enhance practical solutions directly where appropriate, while partnering with Data Scientists and Engineering on more complex development, integration and production deployment.
* Proactive Data Quality & Controls: Develop and enhance automated QC reports, exception monitoring, reconciliations and dashboards using AI and data analytics to proactively identify and prevent data-quality issues before they impact downstream products or clients, reducing operational risk and Data Corrected Cases.
* Data Engineering & Integration: Work with databases, APIs, data feeds and internal platforms to extract, transform, reconcile and validate data across systems. Develop practical solutions to improve data availability, consistency and processing efficiency.
* Content Operations & Market Data: Support day-to-day Real Time Pricing Content activities across Exchange Traded Content, Fixed Income, Forex Money Markets, including instrument onboarding, reference data updates, quality assurance, incident resolution and exchange changes, while identifying opportunities to improve existing workflows.
* Solution Ownership & Governance: Own the development, testing, documentation, deployment and ongoing maintenance of locally developed automation solutions, ensuring adherence to LSEG's technology, data governance, information security and change management standards.
* Technical SME and validation: Provide business rules, labelled examples, complex edge cases, acceptance criteria and structured error feedback to Data Science and Engineering teams. Support evaluation, UAT and human-in-the-loop quality assurance to ensure solutions are accurate, explainable and operationally effective.
* Knowledge building and capability development: Maintain standard operating procedures, data definitions, taxonomies, domain primers, control documentation and training materials. Coach colleagues on new AI-enabled ways of working and share reusable practices across Content Operations.

AI & Process Automation

* Demonstrated hands on experience in applying Generative AI, LLMs, machine learning and intelligent automation to solve business problems, with proven delivery of solutions and measurable outcomes.

* Understand common AI limitations, including hallucinations, incomplete coverage and inconsistent outputs. Experience in appropriate sampling, validation, control and escalation procedures, recognising when automated outputs require human review.

Programming & Technical Capabilities

* Strong working knowledge of Python, SQL, APIs and databases, with practical experience developing automation scripts, data-processing solutions and system integrations.
* Experience developing automated QC checks, exception reports, reconciliations and dashboards, with familiarity in Git, Power BI, Power Automate or similar technologies.

Data Quality & Process Improvement

* Proven experience identifying process inefficiencies and implementing automation to improve STP, reduce manual intervention and strengthen operational efficiency.
* Strong data analysis skills to identify anomalies, develop preventive quality controls, improve exception management and demonstrate measurable improvements in data quality and operational performance.

Financial Markets & Content Operations

* Knowledge of financial markets, market data, reference data or related financial data operations is preferred.
* Understanding of instrument onboarding, exchange driven changes, data maintenance and downstream dependencies, with the ability to apply technical solutions to operational challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and highly organised **Staff Augmentation Coordinator** to manage the end-to-end coordination of contract staffing, resource deployment, client communication and workforce operations.

The ideal candidate will act as a key point of contact between recruiters, contractors, employees, account managers, HR teams, vendors and clients to ensure smooth onboarding, compliance, resource management and engagement throughout the assignment lifecycle.

The role requires strong experience in **staff augmentation, contract staffing operations, vendor coordination, workforce management and client relationship management**.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Resource Onboarding & Deployment**

* Coordinate end-to-end onboarding of selected candidates, contractors and consultants.
* Collect and verify joining documentation, employment records and compliance-related documents.
* Coordinate background verification (BGV), reference checks and other pre-employment requirements.
* Facilitate joining formalities, client induction, system access and deployment readiness.
* Track resource joining dates, deployment schedules and assignment status.
* Coordinate with recruitment teams and account managers to ensure timely resource deployment.

**2. Client & Vendor Coordination**

* Act as the primary operational point of contact for clients regarding deployed resources.
* Coordinate with multiple clients, staffing partners and vendors to ensure smooth workforce operations.
* Manage timesheets, attendance records, leave requests and billing-related information.
* Follow up on client approvals for timesheets, resource extensions and contract renewals.
* Coordinate resource replacements, contract modifications and offboarding activities.
* Address operational queries and escalate client or contractor concerns when required.

**3. Workforce & Resource Management**

* Maintain accurate records of all deployed contractors, consultants and employees.
* Track resource allocation, utilisation, assignment duration and bench availability.
* Monitor contract start dates, end dates, extensions and renewal deadlines.
* Proactively coordinate with clients and account managers regarding upcoming contract expirations.
* Support workforce planning and resource allocation requirements.
* Maintain regular communication with deployed resources to address operational concerns and improve engagement.

**4. Compliance & Contract Documentation**

* Ensure all contractor agreements, employment documents and client-specific compliance requirements are completed.
* Maintain and track **Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA), Master Service Agreements (MSA), Statements of Work (SOW)** and other relevant documents.
* Coordinate with HR, finance and compliance teams to ensure adherence to contractual requirements.
* Maintain organised records of agreements, verification documents and contractor details.
* Assist with contractor onboarding and offboarding compliance processes.

**5. Timesheet, Attendance & Billing Coordination**

* Collect and validate contractor timesheets and attendance records.
* Follow up with clients and contractors for timely timesheet submissions and approvals.
* Coordinate with finance teams for invoice preparation and billing accuracy.
* Track billable hours, approved leave, resource utilisation and contract-related changes.
* Resolve discrepancies in attendance, timesheets and billing information.

**6. Reporting & Stakeholder Management**

* Maintain staffing trackers, resource deployment reports and contractor databases.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on active resources, bench strength, contract renewals and deployment status.
* Maintain accurate MIS reports using Microsoft Excel.
* Coordinate with internal recruitment, HR, payroll, finance and account management teams.
* Support process improvements to increase operational efficiency and minimise resource deployment delays.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline.
* **Minimum 4–5 years of relevant experience in staff augmentation, contract staffing operations or workforce management.**
* Strong understanding of the complete contract staffing lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts, contractors and staffing vendors simultaneously.
* Hands-on experience in resource deployment, timesheet coordination, attendance management and contract renewals.
* Familiarity with NDA, MSA, SOW and contractor compliance documentation.
* **Advanced Microsoft Excel skills**, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and MIS reporting.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management, vendor coordination and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to prioritise tasks, meet deadlines and independently manage multiple assignments.

Preferred Experience

* Previous experience working with an IT staffing company, recruitment consultancy, workforce solutions provider or staff augmentation firm.
* Experience coordinating domestic or international staffing assignments.
* Exposure to Vendor Management Systems (VMS), Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) or workforce management platforms.
* Experience coordinating with client HR, procurement, finance and account management teams.
* Understanding of contractor billing cycles, resource utilisation and service delivery processes.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely onboarding and successful deployment of resources.
* Accuracy of contractor documentation and compliance records.
* Timely timesheet collection and client approvals.
* Contract renewal and extension coordination.
* Accuracy of workforce trackers and MIS reports.
* Client and contractor satisfaction.
* Reduction in onboarding delays and operational escalations.

The ideal candidate should have **4–5 years of hands-on experience in staffing operations or staff augmentation coordination**, with proven expertise in managing contractor deployments, client communication, vendor relationships, compliance documentation and workforce administration.

title: Operations Manager - Healthcare
description:
Our client is hiring for a Project Manager – Healthcare Programme, responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring the Thalassemia Management Programme across designated centres. The role involves coordinating patient-care activities, managing programme teams, monitoring KPIs, handling budgets, and maintaining effective relationships with hospitals, donors, and other stakeholders.

**Job description:**

A. Programme Planning & Implementation

* Develop annual, quarterly, and monthly programme plans in alignment with Sankalp’s organisational objectives.
* Translate programme goals into measurable activities, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Ensure smooth implementation of the Thalassemia Management Programme across all designated centres.
* Monitor programme activities and ensure adherence to approved processes, protocols, and SOPs.
* Identify operational gaps and develop appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure continuity of patient services and minimise disruptions to critical care activities.
* Review programme requirements and recommend improvements in processes, staffing, infrastructure, and resources.

B. Patient-Care Programme Coordination

* Ensure that patients enrolled in the programme receive timely and coordinated support.
* Monitor key patient-care activities such as:
* Regular blood transfusions
* Chelation adherence and monitoring
* Laboratory investigations
* Complication screening
* Patient counselling
* Follow-up and appointment adherence
* Referral and coordination with treating hospitals/doctors
* Ensure proper documentation and tracking of patient-related activities.
* Monitor missed appointments, delayed investigations, and other patient-care gaps and ensure timely follow-up.
* Coordinate with medical and nursing teams to address operational issues affecting patient care.
* Ensure that patient concerns and grievances are appropriately addressed and escalated when required.

C. Team Management & Leadership

* Lead, supervise, and support the programme team, including coordinators, counsellors, nurses, social workers, administrative staff, and other programme personnel.
* Define responsibilities and ensure clarity of roles within the team.
* Conduct regular team meetings and review programme performance.
* Set individual and team objectives in consultation with reporting managers.
* Monitor employee performance, attendance, productivity, and work discipline.
* Identify training and capacity-building requirements.
* Mentor team members and encourage professional development.
* Address performance or behavioural concerns in coordination with HR and senior management.
* Ensure adequate manpower planning and support recruitment requirements.

D. Monitoring, Evaluation & Performance Management

* Develop and monitor programme Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Track patient enrolment, retention, transfusion adherence, follow-up, investigations, counselling, and other programme indicators.
* Prepare regular programme dashboards and performance reports.
* Analyse trends, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
* Conduct periodic programme reviews with the team.
* Establish systems for tracking action points and ensuring timely closure.
* Evaluate programme effectiveness and recommend evidence-based improvements.

E. Data Management & Documentation

* Ensure accurate, complete, and timely entry of programme and patient data.
* Maintain appropriate programme records and documentation.
* Ensure confidentiality and responsible handling of patient information.
* Coordinate with MIS/data teams to ensure accuracy of reports.
* Conduct periodic data verification and identify discrepancies.
* Develop and maintain appropriate trackers and dashboards for programme monitoring.
* Ensure documentation is audit-ready and readily available when required.

F. Financial & Resource Management

* Prepare programme budgets in coordination with the Finance and Senior Management teams.
* Monitor programme expenditure against approved budgets.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of programme resources.
* Review financial requirements and provide timely inputs for budget planning.
* Monitor programme-related procurement and resource requirements.
* Ensure compliance with financial policies and approval processes.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising patient care or programme quality.

G. Donor & Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate with donors, funding partners, hospitals, laboratories, blood centres, government agencies, and other stakeholders as required.
* Prepare timely programme updates, reports, presentations, and impact reports for donors and management.
* Ensure donor commitments and reporting requirements are met within agreed timelines.
* Provide accurate programme data and success stories for donor communication.
* Maintain professional and effective relationships with key stakeholders.
* Represent Sankalp in relevant meetings, workshops, conferences, and programme reviews when delegated.

H. Quality, Compliance & Risk Management

* Ensure programme activities comply with organisational policies, SOPs, applicable statutory requirements, and quality standards.
* Work closely with the Quality team to identify and address process gaps.
* Conduct periodic internal programme reviews.
* Identify operational, patient-care, data, financial, and compliance risks.
* Develop mitigation plans and monitor implementation.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, patient safety, and continuous improvement.

I. Coordination with Medical & Clinical Teams

* Coordinate with treating physicians, consultants, nurses, counsellors, laboratories, blood centres, and hospital teams.
* Facilitate smooth communication between programme and clinical teams.
* Escalate patient-care or clinical concerns to the appropriate medical authority.
* Ensure that the Project Manager does not independently make clinical decisions outside their professional competence.
* Support implementation of approved clinical and programme protocols.

J. Process Improvement

* Regularly review existing programme processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and implement SOPs, workflows, checklists, and monitoring systems where required.
* Use programme data to identify recurring problems and develop sustainable solutions.
* Promote technology-based systems for patient tracking, reporting, communication, and monitoring.

Our client is hiring for a Project Manager – Healthcare Programme, responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring the Thalassemia Management Programme across designated centres. The role involves coordinating patient-care activities, managing programme teams, monitoring KPIs, handling budgets, and maintaining effective relationships with hospitals, donors, and other stakeholders.

**Job description:**

A. Programme Planning & Implementation

* Develop annual, quarterly, and monthly programme plans in alignment with Sankalp’s organisational objectives.
* Translate programme goals into measurable activities, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Ensure smooth implementation of the Thalassemia Management Programme across all designated centres.
* Monitor programme activities and ensure adherence to approved processes, protocols, and SOPs.
* Identify operational gaps and develop appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure continuity of patient services and minimise disruptions to critical care activities.
* Review programme requirements and recommend improvements in processes, staffing, infrastructure, and resources.

B. Patient-Care Programme Coordination

* Ensure that patients enrolled in the programme receive timely and coordinated support.
* Monitor key patient-care activities such as:
* Regular blood transfusions
* Chelation adherence and monitoring
* Laboratory investigations
* Complication screening
* Patient counselling
* Follow-up and appointment adherence
* Referral and coordination with treating hospitals/doctors
* Ensure proper documentation and tracking of patient-related activities.
* Monitor missed appointments, delayed investigations, and other patient-care gaps and ensure timely follow-up.
* Coordinate with medical and nursing teams to address operational issues affecting patient care.
* Ensure that patient concerns and grievances are appropriately addressed and escalated when required.

C. Team Management & Leadership

* Lead, supervise, and support the programme team, including coordinators, counsellors, nurses, social workers, administrative staff, and other programme personnel.
* Define responsibilities and ensure clarity of roles within the team.
* Conduct regular team meetings and review programme performance.
* Set individual and team objectives in consultation with reporting managers.
* Monitor employee performance, attendance, productivity, and work discipline.
* Identify training and capacity-building requirements.
* Mentor team members and encourage professional development.
* Address performance or behavioural concerns in coordination with HR and senior management.
* Ensure adequate manpower planning and support recruitment requirements.

D. Monitoring, Evaluation & Performance Management

* Develop and monitor programme Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Track patient enrolment, retention, transfusion adherence, follow-up, investigations, counselling, and other programme indicators.
* Prepare regular programme dashboards and performance reports.
* Analyse trends, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
* Conduct periodic programme reviews with the team.
* Establish systems for tracking action points and ensuring timely closure.
* Evaluate programme effectiveness and recommend evidence-based improvements.

E. Data Management & Documentation

* Ensure accurate, complete, and timely entry of programme and patient data.
* Maintain appropriate programme records and documentation.
* Ensure confidentiality and responsible handling of patient information.
* Coordinate with MIS/data teams to ensure accuracy of reports.
* Conduct periodic data verification and identify discrepancies.
* Develop and maintain appropriate trackers and dashboards for programme monitoring.
* Ensure documentation is audit-ready and readily available when required.

F. Financial & Resource Management

* Prepare programme budgets in coordination with the Finance and Senior Management teams.
* Monitor programme expenditure against approved budgets.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of programme resources.
* Review financial requirements and provide timely inputs for budget planning.
* Monitor programme-related procurement and resource requirements.
* Ensure compliance with financial policies and approval processes.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising patient care or programme quality.

G. Donor & Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate with donors, funding partners, hospitals, laboratories, blood centres, government agencies, and other stakeholders as required.
* Prepare timely programme updates, reports, presentations, and impact reports for donors and management.
* Ensure donor commitments and reporting requirements are met within agreed timelines.
* Provide accurate programme data and success stories for donor communication.
* Maintain professional and effective relationships with key stakeholders.
* Represent Sankalp in relevant meetings, workshops, conferences, and programme reviews when delegated.

H. Quality, Compliance & Risk Management

* Ensure programme activities comply with organisational policies, SOPs, applicable statutory requirements, and quality standards.
* Work closely with the Quality team to identify and address process gaps.
* Conduct periodic internal programme reviews.
* Identify operational, patient-care, data, financial, and compliance risks.
* Develop mitigation plans and monitor implementation.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, patient safety, and continuous improvement.

I. Coordination with Medical & Clinical Teams

* Coordinate with treating physicians, consultants, nurses, counsellors, laboratories, blood centres, and hospital teams.
* Facilitate smooth communication between programme and clinical teams.
* Escalate patient-care or clinical concerns to the appropriate medical authority.
* Ensure that the Project Manager does not independently make clinical decisions outside their professional competence.
* Support implementation of approved clinical and programme protocols.

J. Process Improvement

* Regularly review existing programme processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and implement SOPs, workflows, checklists, and monitoring systems where required.
* Use programme data to identify recurring problems and develop sustainable solutions.
* Promote technology-based systems for patient tracking, reporting, communication, and monitoring.

Pay: ₹450,000.00 - ₹750,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

The ERP Project Data & Administrative Support Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of laboratory testing unit transactions into the company's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system through batch uploads. The position supports the administrative processing of laboratory testing activities by ensuring that units are properly recorded and charged to the appropriate consulting projects.

A primary responsibility is to monitor ERP batch upload results, review system-generated error reports, and coordinate the resolution of rejected or incorrectly charged transactions. Working closely with project controllers and utilizing the project database, the position will research identified discrepancies, facilitate necessary data corrections, and resubmit corrected transactions into the ERP system.

This position operates as an administrative support function from an offshore or international location and requires regular access to the ERP system, project database, and communication channels with project controllers. Accuracy, attention to detail, consistency, and timely follow-through are essential to maintaining the integrity of project-related transactions.

  

1. ERP Batch Upload Processing

* Prepare and execute routine batch uploads of laboratory testing units into the ERP system.
* Ensure upload files are complete, properly formatted, and consistent with established data requirements.
* Validate source data against required upload fields and established procedures prior to submission.
* Monitor batch upload results and confirm successful processing of transactions.
* Maintain records of completed uploads, including upload dates, batch references, transaction counts, and processing status.
* Escalate system access, formatting, or technical issues that prevent successful uploads.

2. ERP Error Report Review and Resolution

* Retrieve and review ERP-generated error reports following each batch upload.
* Identify units that were rejected, not processed, or incorrectly charged to consulting projects.
* Categorize errors based on the nature of the discrepancy, such as missing project information, invalid project codes, incorrect data, or other ERP validation issues.
* Research discrepancies using the project database and available transaction information.
* Coordinate with the appropriate project controllers to investigate and obtain direction on required corrections.
* Update or coordinate corrections to source data based on guidance and authorization from project controllers.
* Maintain an organized tracking log of outstanding errors, corrective actions, responsible parties, and resolution status.

3. Correction and Resubmission

* Prepare corrected transaction records following confirmation of the required changes.
* Revalidate corrected data to ensure it meets ERP upload requirements.
* Resubmit corrected transactions through the ERP batch upload process.
* Review subsequent ERP processing reports to confirm successful posting and proper project charging.
* Continue follow-up on unresolved errors until successful processing is confirmed.
* Escalate recurring or unresolved issues to the appropriate project controller or supervisor.

4. Reporting and Administrative Coordination

* Maintain accurate records of upload activity, error resolution, and resubmission results.
* Provide periodic status reports summarizing upload volumes, error rates, outstanding items, and resolution progress.

Key Competencies

* Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Ensures transaction data is complete and accurate before submission.
* Problem Solving: Able to investigate data discrepancies and identify the information needed to resolve errors.
* Organization and Follow-Through: Maintains clear tracking of rejected transactions through final resolution.
* Communication: Effectively coordinates with project controllers and internal stakeholders.
* Process Discipline: Consistently follows established upload, correction, approval, and resubmission procedures.
* Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned transactions and ensures errors are followed through to successful processing.

Performance Measures / Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and completeness of initial ERP batch uploads.
* Timeliness of batch upload processing.
* Percentage of transactions successfully processed on the initial upload.
* Timeliness of reviewing and communicating ERP-generated errors.
* Turnaround time for coordinating error corrections and resubmissions.
* Percentage of rejected transactions successfully resolved and posted.
* Number of outstanding or aged unresolved transactions.

This position is primarily responsible for the administrative execution of ERP batch uploads and the coordination of transaction error resolution. Candidates must be based in or within reasonable commuting distance of Bangalore. This role requires the ability to be onsite in our Bangalore, India office as needed.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**

As our Staff Application Security Engineer, you will be the technical authority for how Salesloft secures its SaaS applications, APIs, and microservice architectures. You will decide where and how security is built directly into the software development lifecycle (SDLC), so that engineering teams can ship features quickly without compromising safety. You will join our fast-growing, high-performing Security Engineering team.

A world-class revenue platform depends on security that is designed in from the start, not bolted on at the end. As release velocity increases and AI-enabled features and AI-assisted development reshape how software gets built, the core challenge is building guardrails that are automated, scalable, and trusted by the developers who use them.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

* Architect scalable security controls for our web applications, microservices, and public and private APIs, including authentication and authorization frameworks, cryptography, input validation, and rate limiting.
* Automate security in the pipeline by embedding and tuning SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST, and secret scanning in CI/CD, using AI-assisted triage where it improves signal and speed.
* Lead threat modeling and design reviews with Product Managers and Engineering Architects during early feature design, including risks introduced by AI-enabled features.
* Drive remediation of complex vulnerabilities through deep-dive assessments, pen-test reviews, and bug bounty triage, partnering with engineering pods on root-cause fixes.
* Scale security awareness by developing developer-focused guidelines, delivering secure code training, and leading our Security Champions program across all product squads.

This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll automate what's manual, prototype guardrails before polishing them, and put AI to work wherever it makes our engineers safer and faster. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll build security systems engineered to scale and stand on their own, shaping the architecture of an enterprise SaaS platform trusted by the world's leading revenue organizations.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

You are a deeply technical, proactive AppSec leader who combines a developer's mindset with an offensive security perspective. You excel at translating complex software risks into actionable developer guidance, building automated guardrails that developers love, and establishing technical standards that scale across distributed engineering teams.

You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego: you make decisions with data rather than instinct or seniority, and you give candid, constructive feedback that makes the work better. You bring systems thinking to everything you build, fixing root causes instead of patching symptoms, and you document your work so others can run with it.

If you're looking for a role where you can set the technical direction for application security at scale, this is the right move.

**THE TEAM:**

Our Security Engineering team is made up of seasoned and up-and-coming application security, cloud, and infrastructure engineers. We are results-oriented SaaS professionals with a deep passion for developer enablement and defense-in-depth. The engineers on our team are deeply curious, analytical problem-solvers who are highly collaborative and passionate about shipping secure software at velocity.

The team Moves as One — one group grounded in mutual trust and shared ownership, where we name tension directly instead of working around it. And we are relentlessly Customer-Inspired: every decision traces back to a single question — does this make our customers more successful and their data safer?

**THE SKILL SET:**

* 7+ years of professional experience in Application Security, Product Security, or Software Engineering with a strong security focus, within a modern cloud-native SaaS environment.
* Deep technical expertise in web application security, API security (REST/GraphQL), OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, secure design patterns, and modern authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT).

* Proven experience building and scaling automated AppSec tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning) in enterprise CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins).
* Strong capability to run threat modeling frameworks (e.g., STRIDE) and conduct architectural security reviews across complex microservice ecosystems.
* Track record of managing or triaging bug bounty programs (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd) and converting vulnerability reports into systemic architectural fixes.
* Exceptional communication and developer-mentorship skills, with the ability to build trust and influence engineering pods without direct authority.

**The Role**
------------

The Change Management Specialist drives follow-through action plans arising from Change Control Board (CCB) decisions. The role works with accountable teams to establish clear actions, owners, due dates, and completion evidence; tracks progress; and escalates outstanding items to keep approved changes moving toward closure.

The Specialist maintains visibility into costs to be recouped from partners or customers, working with Finance, Procurement, National and Regional Teams and the responsible customer-facing teams to track recovery actions and financial outcomes. The role also ensures insights from changes are fed back to engineering teams for future design and planning considerations and regularly builds and maintains a shared lessons-learned record.

The focus is disciplined action-plan execution, accurate tracking, reporting, and continuous improvement—not direct leadership of cross-team change-management coordination. Accountable teams retain ownership of implementation, engineering decisions, and commercial or financial approvals.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

### **CCB Action Plans and Follow-Through**

* Translate CCB decisions and conditional approvals into documented action plans with clear deliverables, owners, due dates, dependencies, and completion criteria.
* Drive follow-through by obtaining updates, confirming next steps, and tracking commitments through completion.
* Facilitate action-status reviews, identify missed commitments and cross-team dependencies, and escalate unresolved blockers.
* Maintain CCB action logs and change-request records, including decisions, conditions, ownership, milestones, status, and closure evidence.
* Drive resolution of aging, on-hold, and unresolved change requests, keeping approved items visible until implementation and follow-up are complete.
* Coordinate post-approval handoffs, documentation, and required system, financial, project, or administrative updates. Verify implementation aligns with approved changes.
* Identify recurring gaps in documentation, ownership, handoffs, and follow-through.

### **Partner and Customer Cost Recovery**

* Partner with Finance, commercial, customer-facing, and project teams to identify potentially recoverable costs arising from approved changes and validate responsibility, documentation, and recovery routes.
* Maintain a recovery register linked to change requests, tracking recovery basis, amounts identified and validated, owners, target dates, invoices/claims, amounts recovered, outstanding balances, and disputes.
* Drive follow-up on customer amendments, partner claims, invoices, credits, and supporting evidence; escalate missing documentation, disputes, and overdue recoveries.
* Reconcile recovery status with Finance and retain evidence of payments, credits, settlements, or approved write-offs, clearly distinguishing potential, validated, and realized recovery.
* Coordinate recovery activities while Finance and authorized commercial teams retain responsibility for billing, collections, settlements, and financial approvals.

### **Engineering Feedback and Lessons Learned**

* Capture change drivers, design or scope gaps, implementation issues, and cost impacts, and share relevant findings with Engineering and project teams.
* Track engineering feedback, owners, responses, recommendations, and dispositions, including documented rationale.
* Maintain a lessons-learned register covering issues, confirmed causes, impacts, preventive actions, ownership, and status.
* Highlight recurring themes and track agreed improvement actions through closure to reduce repeat changes and avoidable costs.

### **Progress Reporting and Closure**

* Provide consolidated leadership reporting on action-plan progress, completed and overdue items, aging, dependencies, blockers, financial exposure, and decisions required.
* Report cost-recovery progress by partner/customer and change request, including validated, invoiced/claimed, recovered, outstanding, and disputed amounts.
* Confirm closure with accountable teams using documented completion evidence. Track action implementation and financial recovery separately until resolved, including formally approved exceptions.

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or comparable project management certification preferred
* Professional experience in technology or telecommunications project delivery, engineering support, project controls, or change control; experience with network infrastructure, fiber deployment, or construction programs preferred.
* Hands-on experience maintaining action logs and cost-recovery trackers, preparing status reports, and working with engineering, Finance, Procurement, and project-delivery teams.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

looking for an experienced **Urban Designer / Urban Planner with specialised expertise in sports infrastructure planning and design**. The candidate will be responsible for planning, designing and coordinating multi-sports facilities, integrated sports complexes, stadiums and large-scale sports destinations.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in the planning and design of international-standard sports facilities, including athletics, hockey, cricket, football, motorsports and golf courses.

The role will involve leading sports planning assignments, coordinating multidisciplinary design teams, developing integrated sports master plans and supporting business development opportunities across India and international markets.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Sports Infrastructure Planning & Design**

* Lead planning and urban design of integrated sports cities, sports complexes and multi-sports facilities.
* Develop master plans, spatial strategies, site layouts and functional zoning for sports infrastructure.
* Plan international-standard sports facilities, including:
  + Athletics tracks and field events.
  + Hockey and football pitches.
  + Cricket grounds and stadiums.
  + Motorsport facilities and racing circuits.
  + Indoor sports arenas and multipurpose stadiums.
  + Tennis, basketball, swimming and other sports facilities.
  + Golf courses, driving ranges and golf resorts.
* Integrate spectator facilities, athlete accommodation, training infrastructure, sports academies and supporting amenities.
* Ensure compliance with relevant international sporting federation guidelines and technical requirements.

**B. Golf Course & Specialist Sports Planning**

* Experience in golf course master planning, spatial planning and integration with larger mixed-use developments.
* Understanding of golf course layouts, course circulation, clubhouse planning, practice facilities and landscape integration.
* Coordinate with specialist golf course designers and international consultants.
* Integrate sports facilities with hospitality, recreation, leisure and tourism developments.

**C. Master Planning & Urban Design**

* Lead site analysis, feasibility studies, concept master plans and detailed urban design proposals.
* Develop integrated land-use strategies, circulation networks, infrastructure planning and landscape frameworks.
* Ensure efficient integration of sports venues with surrounding urban developments.
* Incorporate sustainability, climate-responsive design and universal accessibility principles.
* Develop design presentations, technical reports, master plan drawings and client-facing proposals.

**D. Multidisciplinary Design Coordination**

* Coordinate with architecture, structural, MEP, transport, infrastructure, landscape and specialist sports consultants.
* Manage design interfaces between sporting venues, public realm, utilities and supporting infrastructure.
* Ensure technical quality, design consistency and timely delivery of project outputs.
* Support BIM-enabled planning, digital design and visualisation workflows.

**E. Business Development & Client Engagement**

* Support the growth of AECOM's sports infrastructure and urban development portfolio in India.
* Identify opportunities in sports cities, stadium redevelopment, sports academies, golf developments and integrated sports destinations.
* Support technical proposals, presentations, feasibility studies and client engagement.
* Develop relationships with government agencies, sports authorities, private developers, sports federations and institutional clients.
* Collaborate with AECOM's global sports and specialist design teams to leverage international expertise.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture, Urban Planning, Urban Design, Landscape Architecture or a related discipline.
* 10–15 years of relevant professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience in sports infrastructure planning, sports master planning or the design of large-scale sports facilities.
* Proven involvement in at least two or more significant sports infrastructure projects.
* Practical understanding of sports venue planning, international sporting standards, functional requirements and spectator movement.
* Experience in golf course planning and design will be a significant advantage.
* International project experience, particularly in golf, stadiums and multi-sports facilities, will be highly preferred.
* Experience working with international sports consultants, sporting federations or global multidisciplinary design firms will be an added advantage.

  
**Additional Information**

**Desired Competencies**

* Strong urban planning and design capabilities.
* Specialist knowledge of sports infrastructure and venue planning.
* Ability to translate sporting requirements into integrated master plans.
* Strong multidisciplinary coordination and project delivery skills.
* Excellent graphic communication, presentation and visualisation capabilities.
* Client engagement and business development orientation.
* Ability to collaborate with international technical teams.

**Key Performance Expectations**

* Successful delivery of sports master plans and sports infrastructure projects.
* Technical leadership in multi-sports facility planning.
* Contribution to sports infrastructure business development and order-book growth.
* Effective integration of global sports planning expertise.
* Development of strong client relationships and multidisciplinary collaboration.
